literal_meaning: মেজাজ দেখানো (temper showing); মেজাজ হারানো (temper losing)
figurative_meaning_en: getting angry or losing one's temper
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ছোটখাটো কথায় মেজাজ দেখিয়ে দিল।
বসের কথায় শ্রমিক মেজাজ হারিয়ে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: He lost his temper over a trivial matter.
The worker got angry and showed his bad mood after the boss's words.
note: This idiom reflects common expressions of anger in Bengali daily life, with no specific historical origin.
